releases.name: Tidy Tokens
releases.summary: Test your memory playing this classic card game with a twist! Race against the clock to match cards before the time runs out. Consecutive matches score point multipliers and extra lives. Try and beat your high score in the least number of turns and reach the highest rank possible! - Improve your memory and cognitive skills.- Fun for both kids and adults.- Ranks include Beginner, Intermediate, Pro and Master.- Features fluid 3D card animations and sound effects.- No in-app advertisements.

releases.name: Catson Files: Wizard Town
releases.summary: If you love art and beauty, Klimt Jigsaw Puzzle brings you a fine collection of absorbing and fascinating paintings by the great painter Gustav Klimt. Just give a look at the preview pictures to see how beautiful they are. All the major periods of Klimt's artistic production are represented and his most widely known paintings are all included in this app's collection.If you love jigsaw puzzles, this app will offer you hours of delight thanks to its awesome and minimalist interface. It brings you the best experience of doing jigsaw puzzles through carefully timed and non-intrusive animations.The app includes 5 *free* paintings. You can buy 40 more paintings through in-app purchase, if you think you like the app. Upgrading the app will also unlock the hardest difficulty level, totalling to 3 difficulty levels you can choose from.Several options are available to suit your playing style:   - tile rotation: manual, automatic, or no rotation at all;  - image preview: you can hide/show it to help you complete the puzzle;  - levels of difficulty: 3 available (2 in free version);  - magnifying glass: when the tiles are smaller a handy magnifying glass will help you see the details;  - colours: you can customise the puzzle background and its canvas.Furthermore, each painting is accompanied by a short description, so you know which painting you are looking at and you can also read Klimt's bio from within the app.If you feel you would like to see any feature added to this app, just get in touch and let us know!

releases.name: Lucky Break
releases.summary:
Lucky Break is a roguelike deckbuilder that combines addiction, horror, and gambling! Play the slot machine, win big, buy a drink, and keep yourself safe from sadistic mobsters.

The game is set in a dive bar. You play as an addict, who must pay off their gambling debts by playing a cursed slot machine. Fail to pay off your debts, and you might lose your fingers!

releases.name: After the Silence (Coatlicue Estudios)
releases.summary: After the Silence is a first-person psychological horror game whose pillars are immersion and narrative. You explore a typical 1990s Mexican house that keeps changing. Search for keys, advance through the hallways, and solve puzzles as the line between reality and nightmare blurs around you.
